videos.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
videos.description: A charming consultant threatens Boss Baby's role as CEO. Boss attempts to distract him as Staci races to finish the 24-Hour Diaper, a product that'll make the consultant unnecessary.

videos.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
videos.description: On a trip to Chicago, Boss Baby tests his business skills in a promotion battle at a grown-up company, while Gigi and Tim unionize a department store after being denied a return.

videos.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
videos.description: Franz Roll adopts Scissors, thinking he's a dog in 'Scissors is a Good Boy', then in 'Paper's Family Get-Together', Paper avoids a family reunion.
